venue: Knoxville, Tennessee (Bianca Belair's hometown — Smoky Mountain country / Cornette territory / stiff-work lineage / family-as-real)
context: First Raw after Backlash 2026 (Tampa, May 9). Backlash results: Roman retains vs Fatu via underhanded tactics; Bron def Seth (opener); IYO def Asuka; Trick retains US Title vs Sami; Danhausen's team def Miz & Wilson; women's tag titles not defended. Framework scorecard 4/4 on locked picks. Pharmacy's first prescription-check. On-air announcements tonight: SummerSlam 2026 (Aug 1-2, Minnesota) + Clash in Italy (May 31, Turin, presented by Riyadh Season).

segments.outcome: Vision opens — Heyman full heel mouthpiece mode. Roman backstage reiterating 'Jacob doesn't belong here.' Street Profits answer; Montez cuts fatherhood promo in Bianca's hometown. Joe Hendry enters singing the Omaha-composed 'Fire Logan Paul' verse.
segments.notes: Power-position to institutional arm, then autobiographically-loaded babyface answer. Smoky Mountain crowd reads family-as-real — kayfabe membrane dissolves around Montez/Bianca pregnancy. Hendry's crowd-composed lyric survived city change + week gap + territory shift (Omaha legitimacy crowd → Knoxville family crowd). Orphic co-authorship durable across territories.

segments.outcome: Profits + Hendry def Vision (3v3). Rollins interfered to foil Bron — Backlash thread still live. Theory stayed on attack post-match; Rollins ran back to help clear Vision. Post-match Seth and Montez got into it — disagreement, not brawl. Ford didn't ask for the save; Rollins didn't ask permission.
segments.notes: 5/04 brawl formalized as a match. 'Same fight, separate fronts' tested and strained-but-holding. Babyface federation's structural weakness: ego at the seams, earned-pride not heel ego. Vision hierarchy preserved — Bron protected (Seth chased him out), Logan protected by booking, Theory ate the work.

segments.outcome: Pearce books Dom Mysterio vs OG Americano (Chad Gable) for tonight. Americanos Hermanos (OG — Gable + Creeds, not the AAA splinter) being treated as a real faction by the institution.
segments.notes: Cross-faction collision setup: JD prince vs masked legitimacy act. Diamond Mine reunion-under-masks graduating from novelty to roster-integrated unit.

segments.outcome: Pearce transitions from Americanos Hermanos to Garza & Carrillo (Legado del Fantasma remnants, anti-LWO unit from Santos Escobar era). Conversation cut to commercial — specifics deferred.
segments.notes: Setup that gets overwritten in seg-13 — whatever Pearce planned for the Legado remnants, Oba conscripts them through gorilla before it can air.

segments.outcome: Penta in-ring. Page answers, calls for IC shot. Penta says right now; Page refuses — wants SNME stage. Penta accepts. Rusev interrupts: 'Page, you amuse me, but you getting an IC title shot before me doesn't sit well.' Page deferential to Rusev, redirects aggression downward at Evans (claims lies told about him). Evans comes out to confront. Match booked: Evans vs Rusev.
segments.notes: IC picture expanding into a four-body system (Penta/Page/Rusev/Evans). Page demanding SNME = heel vanity but institution agreeing elevates the belt. Rusev/Page crack: enforcer realizes he's doing the work and the talker is getting the shot. Evans = truth-teller refusing to be Page's footnote.

segments.outcome: Je'Von Evans def. Rusev CLEAN. Steven spotted '6-7' twice on broadcast — on Evans's shirt walking in, then before the over-the-rope finishing move.
segments.notes: Generational succession executed in real time. Youngest body in the IC orbit corrects Page's narrative from 5/04. Rusev/Page crack now a canyon — enforcer lost clean to the kid Page was talking down twenty minutes ago. '6-7' double-spot = commentary layer confirming what booking is saying about the vessel the institution is investing in.

segments.outcome: Asuka in single black line across the face — not full paint, not the onryō. Crowns IYO as successor. IYO: 'Even if we fight, we will always be family.' Asuka: 'See you later' (mata ne). Resolution by benediction.
segments.notes: Onryō dropped every layer and became the woman. Three-layer stack (Yamauba authority + Hannya wound + Onryō weapon) dissolved in one segment. 'See you later' not 'goodbye' — senpai walks through the door and leaves it open. Kabuki Warriors arc complete via love, not violence — ghost chose to stop haunting. Institution dispensing dignity — coronation segment on Raw, three-layer deconstruction by the performer herself.

segments.outcome: Brie + Paige in-ring. Raquel + Roxanne come out. Roxanne to Brie: 'You set the bar low' (schoolyard exchange follows). Raquel to Paige: 'Two washed-up has-beens clinging to gold they don't deserve.' Paige and Brie pop off. Liv Morgan attacks Paige (post-stitches Inanna-target). Raquel: 'HAS-BEEN.' JD women stand tall in ring with THREE belts visible (Women's World + tag champions' belts removed).
segments.notes: JD women fully operational as a unit — coven + Raquel-enforcer + Roxanne-apprentice deployed as women's stable with championship infrastructure. Three belts in frame = title-consolidation thesis statement. 'Washed-up has-beens' is THIRD heel faction to run the dismissal frame on Paige/Brie's return (after Fatal Influence 'nostalgia tour' + Irresistible Forces blood). Liv targeting Paige specifically — coven leader attacks Inanna not the gatekeeper. Inanna accumulating physical debt across shows.

segments.outcome: Jimmy in the room first. Roman enters, sits. Jimmy: 'Leave it alone.' Roman: there's gotta be order; if the people and business can't trust... Jacob HAS to acknowledge him. 'If he don't acknowledge me, his ass is outta here.' Jimmy: 'I'm gonna go find Jay.' Cut away.
segments.notes: 'Acknowledge me' = Roman's instinct, not his thesis — old vocabulary surfaces under stress. Reflex, not regression. Diagnostic hold: is the old sickness returning, or the old instinct being metabolized by a new structure? Jimmy doesn't argue — he goes to activate the third node. Family's immune system isn't correcting Roman, it's completing the circuit.

segments.outcome: IYO def Sol Ruca. Showcase / generosity match. Finish: Sol loaded the Sol Snatcher; IYO countered at point of execution into the pin. Not a kickout, not a block — interception at launch.
segments.notes: Phoenix function transferred inside the same broadcast — senpai role inherited from Asuka in seg-07, immediately enacted in seg-10. IYO's first solo-vessel match is a senpai-generosity match. Sol Snatcher counter is the senpai finish: elder doesn't overpower the student's best move, she makes it irrelevant. Sol-as-star + IYO-as-woman-who's-been-ready-longer. Compressed elevation — institution testing if Sol's vessel holds at main-roster speed.

segments.outcome: Jey daps up Jimmy. Jey: 'You talk to OTC?' Jimmy: 'I did.' Jey: 'What'd he say?' Jimmy: 'It was horrible. It was bad. Sometimes, between me and you, I think the OTC get a little bit delusional, man.' Discusses Jacob's likely refusal. Jey: 'That's a different type of family business we got going on here, uce.' Jimmy: 'It is, brother, and this family can be stressful.' Jey: 'Our family is the reason why we here today. Remember that.' Jimmy: 'I'ma go out there with the OTC.' Tells Jey 'Good luck with Jacob.' They dap up. Both subdued Yeet.
segments.notes: Bloodline operating at a register that has never existed before. Jimmy calling Roman 'delusional' — lovingly, worriedly, between brothers — is not betrayal but family seeing the patriarch clearly and choosing to stay anyway. The triangle is NOT equal: Jimmy goes WITH Roman, Jey goes TO Jacob. Twins as EMTs — triage system distributing across both sides of the family wound to keep the body alive. 'This family can be stressful' works in both registers — membrane is gone. Scroll seed: 'The Subdued Yeet.'

segments.outcome: Seth looking for allies, comes to the Profits asking for partnership. Montez reminds him: you chose this path. The 'revolutionary' thing isn't really a thing. Profits walk away. Seth stares into their wake, thinking.
segments.notes: Lone wolf's structural problem made explicit. Can't decline the invitation and then show up at the party. Bound-Loki's crisis: founded the Shield, founded Breakker's credential, founded the Authority weapon-era — archetypal function is to create things that devour him. Now wants to create an alliance, but the people he wants won't be devoured and won't be led. Image of the show for Seth: just watching other people walk away.

segments.outcome: Open challenge. Nobody answers. Pearce comes out to cancel. Oba refuses cancellation — leaves ring, goes through gorilla position, physically grabs Garza + Carrillo (the Legado remnants from seg-04), drags them back through gorilla to the ring, beats them down.
segments.notes: Orisha doesn't accept 'no petitioners.' Yoruba-open evolves from 'who is worthy to answer' into 'orisha takes what he needs.' Gorilla position used as fourth-wall threshold — Oba broke the production boundary, dragged backstage bodies into ritual space. Behavioral credential added to streak: 'this man goes get his own opponents when the institution fails to provide them.' Invincibility + sovereignty + initiative. Two consecutive shows of Pearce being structurally overridden (Roman accepting Tribal Combat to come on 5/18 is the inheritor).

segments.outcome: Pre-match: Bálor takes out JD McDonagh backstage on the way to the ring. Dom arrives without backup. Dom def Chad Gable.
segments.notes: Bálor's revenge arc shifts to surgical isolation — not attacking Dom or Liv, just the specific body that would interfere. Fomorian-exile operating as saboteur. Dom won clean without his shield — the prince proved he can function alone when forced to. Bálor's strategy worked tactically (JD removed) but failed diagnostically (Dom didn't need him). Gable/Americanos program closes for Dom — his real trajectory is wherever Bálor pushes him.

segments.outcome: Megyn Kelly: 'That was a good promo, Logan.' Brief media-crossover moment. Fox News anchor validating the Influencer's promo work.
segments.notes: Institution's media arm and the content-creator class in the same frame. Right-media validation of Vision's voice = the operative class's external alliance made visible.

segments.outcome: Roman in ring with Jimmy — 'acknowledge me' ceremony, Euro-cadence chant. Split-screen: Jey approaches Jacob backstage with full diplomatic appeal ('Be smart, uce. Please'). Jacob answers with head grab + multiple headbutts at the gorilla position. Jacob to camera: 'You want me to acknowledge you, Roman?' On the way to ring, Jacob takes out Jimmy on the ramp — both twins eliminated. Roman alone in ring. Steel chair pulled — Spear loaded — Jacob superkick. Tongan Death Grip (THIRD use). Jacob escapes to outside — strips announce table — Roman Superman Punch caught into the Grip — Jacob power-drives Roman through the announce table. Commentary: 'gone off the deep end.' Crowd shifts mixed → 'FATU FATU.'
segments.notes: Triage system destroyed in sequence. Acknowledgment ceremony became anti-acknowledgment. Steel chair = Roman's confession that words/ceremony/family-mediation all failed (Jimmy was right: 'a little bit delusional'). Tongan Death Grip third use — sacred-move violation has become Jacob's thesis statement, taboo only has power if the violator feels shame. Jacob feels none. Gorilla used as threshold twice tonight (Oba + Jacob/Jey) — production boundary treated as meaningful liminal space, both violations were acts of force. Knoxville family-code crowd processing the civil war in real time — splitting, can't choose.

segments.outcome: Show was over. Jacob came back for one more spear on Roman. Crowd chanting 'FATU FATU' — not mixed anymore. Final image: Jacob standing over wreckage — Roman through announce table, Jimmy down on ramp, Jey down at gorilla. Reigns infrastructure laid out across three zones. OTC DOA.
segments.notes: Extra spear after the show ended IS the tell. Booking gave the stand-tall; Jacob gave himself the exclamation point. Institution said 'scene over.' Aitu said 'I decide when it's over.' Crowd flipped from mixed to FATU on the extra spear — family-code territory chose the man who broke every family code. The crowd's medicine isn't always order — sometimes it's the man who refuses order entirely. PLE calendar announced on broadcast: SummerSlam 2026 Aug 1-2 Minnesota + Clash in Italy 5/31 Turin (presented by Riyadh Season).
